title: TUON: A Tensor-Aware Optimizer Utilizing Tensor-SVD and Polarization for Large Language Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.35130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large scale language model~(LLM) pretraining is increasingly bottlenecked by optimizer efficiency, driving optimizer design from vector-aware methods such as AdamW to matrix-aware methods. Matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon exploit matrix structure but treat layers independently, neglecting cross-layer correlations. Tensor-aware optimizers are therefore needed, yet existing ones rely on a matricization-based tensor algebra and remain restricted to shallow stacking and specific modules. In this paper, we propose \textbf{TUON}, a novel optimizer built on a transform-based tensor algebra derived from the Tensor-SVD (T-SVD). Unlike methods that polarize a globally unfolded matrix, TUON mixes layers via a unitary transform $\boldsymbol{Q}$ and then polarizes each transformed slice, and inverts the transform to recover the update. This mix-then-separate strategy captures cross-layer correlations while preserving per-layer diversity, avoiding

translated_title: TUON：一种利用张量SVD与极化分解的大语言模型预训练张量感知优化器
translated_abstract: 大规模语言模型（LLM）预训练日益受到优化器效率的瓶颈制约，这推动优化器设计从AdamW等向量感知方法演进到矩阵感知方法。以Muon为代表的矩阵感知优化器虽然利用了矩阵结构，但各层之间相互独立处理，忽略了跨层相关性。因此人们需要张量感知的优化器，然而现有方法依赖于基于矩阵化的张量代数，且仍局限于浅层堆叠和特定模块。本文提出TUON，一种基于由张量SVD（T-SVD）导出的变换型张量代数构建的新型优化器。与对全局展开矩阵直接进行极化分解的方法不同，TUON先通过酉变换Q混合各层，再对每个变换后的切片进行极化分解，最后通过逆变换恢复更新量。这种“先混合后分离”的策略在捕获跨层相关性的同时保留了各层的多样性，避免了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出TUON，一种基于张量SVD变换型张量代数的优化器，通过“先混合后分离”的酉变换极化策略捕获跨层相关性并保留各层多样性，突破现有张量感知优化器局限于浅层堆叠与特定模块的限制，服务于大语言模型预训练。
en_tdlr: TUON is a novel tensor-aware optimizer built on a transform-based tensor algebra derived from Tensor-SVD, which captures cross-layer correlations while preserving per-layer diversity via a mix-then-separate polarization strategy, overcoming the limitations of existing tensor-aware optimizers restricted to shallow stacking and specific modules in LLM pretraining.
